(2) The scene shifts to the interior of a lingerie store with racks of bras visible in the background. The main character is seen from behind entering the store, wearing a white lace dress over her sweater. A sales assistant uses a measuring tape to measure her underbust. (3) Inside a fitting room with floral wallpaper, the woman takes selfies using a handheld gimbal camera, showcasing different bras she is trying on. (4) Close-up shots focus on the price tags of the lingerie, specifically showing the size 'D70'. (5) The two women are back in the mall corridor, the main character holding a red shopping bag with festive illustrations. They interact playfully, gesturing toward the bag. (6) A promotional graphic appears with product boxes and text detailing ingredients and benefits, followed by the woman holding the gimbal and smiling.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a shopping trip for lingerie to show physical changes after using a specific breast enhancement product, aiming to validate the product's effectiveness through a size increase and encourage viewers to purchase it during a holiday promotion.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product 'Bo Bo Dong' (波波凍) and its nutritional information card, accompanied by a promotional offer for the Lunar New Year.
